research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ola Electric is researching vehicle and battery technologies. Work on a dual pass cooling system for battery pack cooling, a pouch cell holder assembly and battery pack for electric vehicle, and current collector plates for batteries targets thermal and structural management. A unified braking system for vehicles and automatic locking and unlocking of vehicles enhance control, while smart charging recommendations for electric vehicles advance charging intelligence. These efforts span battery design, battery materials, vehicle controls, and charging optimization.

overview_description.description:
Ola Electric Mobility engages in the leasing of electric cars. It offers shared daily mobility and deploys charging and battery swapping networks that focus on the commercial electric vehicle segment to make electric mobility convenient, dependable, and affordable.

Ankit Jain and Anand Shah founded Ola Electric Mobility on May 26, 2017. It has its headquarters in Bengaluru, India.

product.name: Ola S1 Electric Scooters
product.description: A range of electric scooters for urban commuting, including the S1 Pro+, S1 Pro, S1 X+ and S1 X, with connected software and multiple battery configurations.

product.description: A family of electric motorcycles comprising Roadster X, Roadster X+, Roadster and Roadster Pro, designed for performance-oriented and longer-distance riding.

product.name: Ola Shakti
product.description: An integrated lithium-ion battery and inverter system for residential energy storage, providing backup power for household appliances and supporting future solar integration.

product.name: MoveOS
product.description: Ola Electric’s software platform for connected vehicle functions, including riding modes, navigation, diagnostics, location services and software-based feature updates.

product.name: 4680 Bharat Cell Platform
product.description: An India-developed cylindrical battery-cell platform and 1.5 kWh battery pack intended for electric mobility, robotics, drones, medical devices and other energy-intensive hardware.

product.name: Ola Hypercharger Network
product.description: A public charging network for Ola electric vehicles, providing charging access for riders, including support for longer-distance travel.
